title: cenia turbinata
intro: Cenia turbinata, commonly known as the "Turbinated Cenia" or "Turbinated Plant", is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae, native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as reducing inflammation and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cenia turbinata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents in Cenia turbinata contribute to its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
